sections.heading: Back page: fiction
lines: From the fuel desk: The coffee is the same.
A driver asked me this week whether the coffee on pump side is fresher than the coffee by the register. It is the same pot. I carry it across the store when the first one runs low.
He bought a cup from each anyway and said the pump side one was better. I did not argue. He had 600 miles to go and I had a floor to mop.
Help wanted: Great Lakes Training Transport, Milwaukee.

New drivers wanted. Short loads, extra room on the appointment, and good stop pay on a short hop. We supply the truck and pay for its upkeep. Most of our drivers leave for a bigger carrier once they have the hang of it, and we wish them well.
Heard on the CB: Northbound, somewhere past the scale.
"Is the scale open?" "It was when I went by." "When was that?" "Tuesday."
